Additionally, the CO must be dehydrated before being introduced into the 2 pipeline, and the concentrations of O and H S must be tightly controlled in the emitter’s capture process 2 2 in accordance with PHMSA regulations to prevent issues such as corrosion and stress cracking. In the T-RICH plant, the stripper partially separates non-condensable gases such as O , H₂, N , CO, Argon, 2 2 and CH from the rich CO stream. The incoming gas from the pipeline to the T-RICH plant may require 4 2 additional treatment (e.g. removal of O /Amines and its degradation products) to meet the CO product 2 2 specifications.
